_about: The starter pack (companion/images/meme_pictures.py): pictures in the public domain (Public Domain Mark) or dedicated to it (CC0), so they ship with the app. Medieval animals from manuscripts in the KB, National Library of the Netherlands (mostly Jacob van Maerlant's Der naturen bloeme), and old paintings, prints and photos from museums, found through Europeana and the open access collections of the Art Institute of Chicago, the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Each entry names its source. No people in the foreground, and nobody young.
